name: Legal Deadline Calculator
description: Count calendar or business days from a trigger date, skip weekends and federal holidays, and see the count on a calendar.

name: Post-Judgment Interest Calculator
description: Interest on a federal civil judgment under 28 U.S.C. 1961, computed daily and compounded annually, with a year-by-year chart.

name: Billable Hours Calculator
description: Convert minutes to billable hours with any increment, track an annual target, and model realization and collections.

name: Law Firm KPI Calculator
description: Utilization, realization, collection, margin, revenue per lawyer, and intake funnel metrics from your own totals.

name: Law Firm SEO ROI Calculator
description: Model SEO return from your own costs, fees, and intake rates, with low, base, and high scenarios, payback month, and break-even clients.

name: Legal Software Cost Calculator
description: Compare up to three legal software plans by monthly, first-year, and contract-length cost, with setup fees spread across every user.

name: Payment Processing Fee Calculator
description: See what card and eCheck payments cost your firm each month, your effective rate, and the saving if more clients pay by bank transfer.

name: eDiscovery Cost Calculator
description: Compare per-GB, per-user, and per-case tier pricing for one matter, with culling after early case assessment.

name: Contingency Fee Calculator
description: Break a settlement into attorney fee, case costs, liens, and the client's net, with costs taken out before or after the fee.
